info.name: 📌 StepFun API
info.description:
### About StepFun

"Leading models and tools to accelerate the deployment of your next AI app."

StepFun builds its own Step models and serves them through an OpenAI-compatible API. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Model makers**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- StepFun Account: [https://platform.stepfun.ai/](https://platform.stepfun.ai/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `stepfun_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:stepfun_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://platform.stepfun.ai/docs/en/api-reference/chat/chat-completion-create](https://platform.stepfun.ai/docs/en/api-reference/chat/chat-completion-create)
    
- Models: [https://platform.stepfun.ai/docs/en/guides/developer/openai](https://platform.stepfun.ai/docs/en/guides/developer/openai)
